GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2021-06-30T15:19:13Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: PNG to JPEG: how to keep high quality
Description: Hello ! 

I'm trying to convert PNG image buffer to a JPEG image buffer.
It's working but I have a quality loss when I'm displaying the JPEG from Buffer.

Here my simple code to convert PNG to JPEG:
```javascript
formatted = await sharp(pngImgBuffer)
      .toFormat('jpeg')
      .jpeg({ quality: 100, chromaSubsampling: '4:4:4', force: true })
      .toBuffer(); // JPEG buffer
```

And the reading part (with resize):
```javascript
resized = await sharp(jpegImgBuffer)
      .resize(width, height)
      .toFormat('jpeg')
      .jpeg({ quality: 100, chromaSubsampling: '4:4:4', force: true })
      .toBuffer();
```

Is there something wrong in my code ? Or something else to do to improve the quality of the result ?
